## What this region is

How the agent is expected to work in this repo, and the documentation workflow: read the relevant doc and FEATURES.md / COMPARISONS.md before assuming something is missing ("are you sure we don't have that already"), understand the why first, decompose, build the correct interface rather than simple-first, verify commands yourself before handing them to the user ("why are you having me run things you didn't try"), edit files by hand rather than through sed, explain the design before implementing, fix pre-existing issues you hit rather than skipping them, no backwards-compat aliases, no comments, don't swallow errors, keep scratch notes and experiments in the tmp AI workspace and test risky changes in tmp first, don't remove other agents' in-progress work, put open questions in tickets, and keep docs honest with a regenerated TOC. Any instruction about the agent's method, as opposed to the code's behaviour, is here.

## What it exists for

- Decide where unfinished, extra or changed writing goes
- Run a task under the agent process rules (intake, contract, breaker)
- Find what exists and verify a claim before acting

## How people say these problems

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- What touches caching → lib-atlas
- What do I call the two ends of this relation → conventions
- Which import path do I use → monorepo-architecture
- Get this repo running on my machine → dx-setup
